title: PM Checklist Input
description: Standardized input contract for a preventive-maintenance checklist item. Field names mirror the runtime work_orders table (src/db/schema/cmms_schema.sql), which folds pm_schedules' cycle definition into pm_cycle_days rather than a separate table. Reference-only for next-phase RBAC/PM runtime wiring — does not replace existing WOItem types (src/types/lng.ts) or DAOs (src/adapters/db/workOrderDao.ts).

checklistItems.description: Itemized PM checklist entries for this work order
